title: Titanium Derailleur Limit Screw

alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Derailleur Limit Screw because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Front/rear derailleur H/L limit adjustment screw. This rationale is driven by front/rear derailleur h/l limit adjustment screw and service environment demands.

commonFailures: Bearing race brinelling from over-torque - avoided by torque-limiting press-fit tool with ±2% accuracy — critical for frontrear derailleur hl performance

faq.q: Does Titanium Derailleur Limit Screw require special assembly or anti-seize?
faq.a: Yes. Titanium-to-titanium threaded interfaces on Titanium Derailleur Limit Screw are susceptible to galling (cold welding) during assembly. Application of MoS₂ or copper-based anti-seize compound to all threaded contact surfaces is mandatory. Lubricated installation torque values are typically 15-20% lower than dry values. Thread engagement should not exceed 3× thread diameter.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Derailleur Limit Screw?
faq.a: Each Titanium Derailleur Limit Screw shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for frontrear derailleur hl.
